name: GPMC 战略层大屏
description: 项目综合态势总览模板，面向集团领导的一屏全局态势感知。

actions.panelBodyTemplate:
面向集团领导，一屏判断项目是否健康、投资执行是否偏离、风险是否失控。
• 优先关注项目总数、在建、延期、高风险四组总览指标。
• 结合预算与执行、完成率趋势、事业部排名判断全局健康度。
• 从异常项目与专题聚焦区定位需要继续追问的管控专题。

面向集团领导，一屏判断项目是否健康、投资执行是否偏离、风险是否失控。
• 优先关注项目总数、在建、延期、高风险四组总览指标。
• 结合预算与执行、完成率趋势、事业部排名判断全局健康度。
• 从异常项目与专题聚焦区定位需要继续追问的管控专题。

建议按“总览态势 → 问题专题 → 执行明细”的顺序讲解，不打断全局浏览。
• 先讲“延期项目”和“高风险项目”，再进入对应管控看板。
• 看板里的指标、榜单和清单继续下钻到执行层只读页面。
• 执行层只承载明细与跟进情况，不在演示中编辑数据。

→ 项目执行监控：查看延期 TOP10、里程碑与阻塞链路。
→ 质量信息与跟进：查看质量问题规模、闭环率与措施清单。
→ 技术状态与跟进：查看技术状态变更、签署率与未闭环项。
→ 成本与预算控制：查看预算执行、偏差和周期支出趋势。
→ 风险与预警中心：查看风险矩阵、分布与闭环情况。

sqlConfig.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.project_no) AS "项目总数", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.incomplete_cnt > 0 THEN s.project_no END) AS "进行中项目", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.incomplete_cnt > 0 AND (s.overdue_incomplete_unchanged_non_general_cnt > 0 OR s.overdue_incomplete_changed_non_general_cnt > 0) THEN s.project_no END) AS "延期项目" FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.project_no) AS "项目总数", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.incomplete_cnt > 0 THEN s.project_no END) AS "进行中项目", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.incomplete_cnt > 0 AND (s.overdue_incomplete_unchanged_non_general_cnt > 0 OR s.overdue_incomplete_changed_non_general_cnt > 0) THEN s.project_no END) AS "延期项目" FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.project_no) AS "项目总数", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.incomplete_cnt > 0 THEN s.project_no END) AS "进行中项目", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.incomplete_cnt > 0 AND (s.overdue_incomplete_unchanged_non_general_cnt > 0 OR s.overdue_incomplete_changed_non_general_cnt > 0) THEN s.project_no END) AS "延期项目" FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]

WITH p AS (SELECT SUM(due_cnt) AS due, SUM(on_time_cnt) AS on_time, SUM(incomplete_cnt) AS incomplete, SUM(incomplete_high_risk_cnt) AS hi_inc, SUM(milestone_on_time_cnt) AS ms_ot, SUM(milestone_total_cnt) AS ms_t, SUM(abnormal_pending_non_general_cnt) AS abn, SUM(overdue_incomplete_unchanged_non_general_cnt) AS ov_unc, SUM(overdue_incomplete_changed_non_general_cnt) AS ov_chg, SUM(incomplete_milestone_cnt) AS inc_ms FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]) SELECT CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.on_time::numeric/p.due::numeric*100,2) END AS "按时完成率", CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((p.ov_unc+p.ov_chg)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100,2) END AS "超期率", CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((p.abn+p.ov_unc)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100,2) END AS "异常率", CASE WHEN p.ms_t=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.ms_ot::numeric/p.ms_t::numeric*100,2) END AS "里程碑按时率", CASE WHEN p.incomplete=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.hi_inc::numeric/p.incomplete::numeric*100,2) END AS "高风险未完成占比", ROUND((CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.on_time::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(CASE WHEN p.ms_t=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.ms_ot::numeric/p.ms_t::numeric*100 END)*0.3+(100-(CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE (p.abn+p.ov_unc)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END))*0.3,2) AS "进度健康度", p.inc_ms*3+p.hi_inc*2+p.ov_unc*1 AS "风险预警指数" FROM p

WITH p AS (SELECT SUM(due_cnt) AS due, SUM(on_time_cnt) AS on_time, SUM(incomplete_cnt) AS incomplete, SUM(incomplete_high_risk_cnt) AS hi_inc, SUM(milestone_on_time_cnt) AS ms_ot, SUM(milestone_total_cnt) AS ms_t, SUM(abnormal_pending_non_general_cnt) AS abn, SUM(overdue_incomplete_unchanged_non_general_cnt) AS ov_unc, SUM(overdue_incomplete_changed_non_general_cnt) AS ov_chg, SUM(incomplete_milestone_cnt) AS inc_ms FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]) SELECT CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.on_time::numeric/p.due::numeric*100,2) END AS "按时完成率", CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((p.ov_unc+p.ov_chg)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100,2) END AS "超期率", CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((p.abn+p.ov_unc)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100,2) END AS "异常率", CASE WHEN p.ms_t=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.ms_ot::numeric/p.ms_t::numeric*100,2) END AS "里程碑按时率", CASE WHEN p.incomplete=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.hi_inc::numeric/p.incomplete::numeric*100,2) END AS "高风险未完成占比", ROUND((CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.on_time::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(CASE WHEN p.ms_t=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.ms_ot::numeric/p.ms_t::numeric*100 END)*0.3+(100-(CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE (p.abn+p.ov_unc)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END))*0.3,2) AS "进度健康度", p.inc_ms*3+p.hi_inc*2+p.ov_unc*1 AS "风险预警指数" FROM p

SELECT s.plan_month AS "月份", SUM(s.on_time_cnt) AS "按时完成", SUM(s.overdue_completed_cnt) AS "超期完成", SUM(s.incomplete_cnt) AS "未完成" FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] GROUP BY s.plan_month ORDER BY s.plan_month

SELECT SUM(s.on_time_cnt) AS "按时完成", SUM(s.overdue_completed_cnt) AS "超期完成", SUM(s.incomplete_cnt) AS "未完成", SUM(s.pending_normal_cnt) AS "正常待完成", SUM(s.abnormal_pending_non_general_cnt) AS "不正常待变更" FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]

SELECT SUM(s.open_cat_design) AS "设计", SUM(s.open_cat_process) AS "工艺", SUM(s.open_cat_management) AS "管理", SUM(s.open_cat_component) AS "元器件", SUM(s.open_cat_operation) AS "操作", SUM(s.open_cat_outsource) AS "外协外购", SUM(s.open_cat_software) AS "软件", SUM(s.open_cat_other) AS "其他" FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]

SELECT project_no AS "项目编号", subsystem AS "分系统", node_task AS "节点任务", node_type AS "节点类型", owner AS "负责人", dept AS "责任科室", completion_status AS "完成情况", risk_level AS "风险等级", plan_date AS "计划时间", delay_days AS "延期天数" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] AND is_incomplete = true ORDER BY delay_days DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

WITH p AS (SELECT SUM(due_cnt) AS due, SUM(on_time_cnt) AS on_time, SUM(milestone_on_time_cnt) AS ms_ot, SUM(milestone_total_cnt) AS ms_t, SUM(abnormal_pending_non_general_cnt) AS abn, SUM(overdue_incomplete_unchanged_non_general_cnt) AS ov_unc FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]), q AS (SELECT SUM(new_issue_cnt) AS n, SUM(open_issue_cnt) AS o, SUM(zero_completed_cnt) AS z, SUM(no_zero_plan_cnt) AS np FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]), t AS (SELECT SUM(total_change_cnt) AS total, SUM(order_signed_cnt) AS sgn, SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii) AS unsgn, SUM(reform_done_i_ii) AS rd, SUM(reform_pending_i_ii) AS rp FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]), prog_h AS (SELECT ((CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.on_time::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(CASE WHEN p.ms_t=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.ms_ot::numeric/p.ms_t::numeric*100 END)*0.3+(100-(CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE (p.abn+p.ov_unc)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END))*0.3) AS h FROM p), qual_h AS (SELECT ((CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE q.z::numeric/q.n::numeric*100 END)*0.5+(CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE (q.n-q.np)::numeric/q.n::numeric*100 END)*0.3+(100-(CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE q.o::numeric/q.n::numeric*100 END))*0.2) AS h FROM q), tech_h AS (SELECT ((CASE WHEN (t.sgn+t.unsgn)=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.sgn::numeric/(t.sgn+t.unsgn)::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(CASE WHEN (t.rd+t.rp)=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.rd::numeric/(t.rd+t.rp)::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(100-(CASE WHEN t.total=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.unsgn::numeric/t.total::numeric*100 END))*0.2) AS h FROM t) SELECT ROUND((prog_h.h*0.4 + qual_h.h*0.3 + tech_h.h*0.3)::numeric, 2) AS "综合健康度" FROM prog_h, qual_h, tech_h

WITH p AS (SELECT SUM(due_cnt) AS due, SUM(on_time_cnt) AS on_time, SUM(milestone_on_time_cnt) AS ms_ot, SUM(milestone_total_cnt) AS ms_t, SUM(abnormal_pending_non_general_cnt) AS abn, SUM(overdue_incomplete_unchanged_non_general_cnt) AS ov_unc FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]) SELECT ROUND((CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.on_time::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(CASE WHEN p.ms_t=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.ms_ot::numeric/p.ms_t::numeric*100 END)*0.3+(100-(CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE (p.abn+p.ov_unc)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END))*0.3, 2) AS "进度健康分" FROM p

WITH q AS (SELECT SUM(new_issue_cnt) AS n, SUM(open_issue_cnt) AS o, SUM(zero_completed_cnt) AS z, SUM(no_zero_plan_cnt) AS np, SUM(open_cat_design) AS d FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]) SELECT CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(q.z::numeric/q.n::numeric*100,2) END AS "归零率", ROUND((CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE q.z::numeric/q.n::numeric*100 END)*0.5+(CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE (q.n-q.np)::numeric/q.n::numeric*100 END)*0.3+(100-(CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE q.o::numeric/q.n::numeric*100 END))*0.2,2) AS "质量健康分" FROM q

WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(total_change_cnt) AS total, SUM(new_cat_i) AS cat_i, SUM(order_signed_cnt) AS signed, SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii) AS unsigned, SUM(reform_done_i_ii) AS reform_done, SUM(reform_pending_i_ii) AS reform_pending FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]) SELECT ROUND((CASE WHEN (t.signed+t.unsigned)=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.signed::numeric/(t.signed+t.unsigned)::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(CASE WHEN (t.reform_done+t.reform_pending)=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.reform_done::numeric/(t.reform_done+t.reform_pending)::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(100-(CASE WHEN t.total=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.unsigned::numeric/t.total::numeric*100 END))*0.2,2) AS "技术状态健康分" FROM t

SELECT s.period_month AS "月份", SUM(s.new_issue_cnt) AS "新增问题", SUM(s.zero_completed_cnt) AS "归零完成", SUM(s.open_issue_cnt) AS "现存问题" FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] GROUP BY s.period_month ORDER BY s.period_month

SELECT SUM(s.high_cnt) AS "高风险", SUM(s.mid_cnt) AS "中风险", SUM(s.low_cnt) AS "低风险" FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]

SELECT SUM(s.new_cat_i) AS "I类更改", SUM(s.new_cat_ii) AS "II类更改", SUM(s.new_cat_iii) AS "III类更改" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]

SELECT SUM(s.total_risk_cnt) AS "风险总数", SUM(s.high_cnt) AS "高风险", SUM(s.mid_cnt) AS "中风险", SUM(s.low_cnt) AS "低风险", SUM(s.released_cnt) AS "已释放", SUM(s.open_cnt) AS "未释放" FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]

SELECT SUM(s.on_time_cnt) AS "按时完成", SUM(s.overdue_completed_cnt) AS "超期完成", SUM(s.incomplete_cnt) AS "未完成", SUM(s.pending_normal_cnt) AS "正常待完成", SUM(s.abnormal_pending_non_general_cnt)+SUM(s.overdue_incomplete_unchanged_non_general_cnt) AS "异常" FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]
